scenario: Create new Provider database
preconditions: No database exists at destination
expected_result: New WAL database created with PBKDF2 verifier and restricted file mode
required_evidence: Provision report and database metadata
notes: Unit-test equivalent executed in CI; formal acceptance remains open

scenario: Refuse overwrite of existing database
preconditions: Destination already exists
expected_result: Operation rejected without modifying original bytes
required_evidence: Original file digest unchanged

scenario: Reject invalid bearer secret
preconditions: Principal is provisioned
expected_result: Provider session construction denied
required_evidence: Typed authorization exception and no data mutation
notes: PBKDF2 verifier only; no network IAM

scenario: Do not persist plaintext principal secret
preconditions: Database provisioned
operation: Inspect database bytes and verifier columns
expected_result: Plaintext secret is absent and per-principal salt/hash stored
required_evidence: Database inspection and file mode
notes: OS directory and WAL/SHM controls remain deployment responsibilities

scenario: Reject prefix outside ACL
preconditions: Principal allowed only cnc/ch17
operation: Attempt object write under another prefix
expected_result: Write rejected before object or fence mutation
required_evidence: DENY audit row and unchanged scope state
notes: Denied audit may not persist when DB is unavailable

scenario: Reject action outside ACL
preconditions: Principal lacks object:write_fenced
expected_result: Write rejected
required_evidence: Authorization result and no mutation
notes: Action ACL is persisted per principal

scenario: Isolate identical object key across tenants
preconditions: Two principals use different tenant IDs
operation: Write and read same key per tenant
expected_result: Each tenant sees only its own object bytes
required_evidence: Principal tenant and retrieved object contents

scenario: Require key be inside authorized package scope
preconditions: Scope does not contain requested object key
expected_result: Write rejected as authorization error
required_evidence: Scope/key pair and unchanged fence table
notes: Prevents prefix collision and scope escape

scenario: Reject stale token across object keys
preconditions: Package scope high-water already advanced
operation: Write another key with lower token
expected_result: Older token rejected and target key remains absent
required_evidence: Scope high-water and object inventory

scenario: Replay same operation with newer token
preconditions: Operation committed but caller did not receive response
operation: Replay same operation key/content with a newer token
expected_result: Original object result returned and high-water advances
required_evidence: Operation row count and object digest
notes: Replay doesn't create a second immutable object

scenario: Reject idempotency key content conflict
preconditions: Same scope and idempotency key already exists
expected_result: Operation rejected
required_evidence: Stored original digest and conflict exception

scenario: Reject same token for different operation
preconditions: Scope high-water equals submitted token and no prior operation receipt
expected_result: Operation rejected and high-water unchanged
required_evidence: Token and operation rows
notes: One fencing token cannot authorize two unrelated writes

scenario: Rollback object when fence metadata commit fails
preconditions: Fault injection raises after object mutation and before transaction commit
expected_result: Neither object nor high-water nor idempotency receipt remains
required_evidence: Database rows and exception trace

scenario: Commit begin and part state with fence
preconditions: Authorized active package session
operation: Begin session and write checksummed parts
expected_result: Each mutation advances same package scope and commits atomically
required_evidence: Session/part rows and scope high-water

scenario: Commit complete object with fence receipt
preconditions: All parts complete and valid
expected_result: Object
required_evidence: COMPLETE state
synthetic_only: fence and idempotency receipt commit atomically

scenario: Replay completion after response loss
preconditions: Complete transaction commits but response hook raises timeout
operation: Retry same completion idempotency key with newer token
expected_result: Original completed object returned without a second commit
required_evidence: Object identity and operation row count

scenario: Two processes compete on one package scope
preconditions: Two independent spawned processes share local SQLite DB and scope
expected_result: Final high-water is 201 and later token 200 is rejected
required_evidence: Process outcomes scope row and object rows

scenario: Publish a complete backup through strict adapter
preconditions: SQLite coordinator DB and SQLite fenced Provider DB are provisioned
expected_result: Payload and receipt published with package-scoped high-water
required_evidence: Publish receipt verification result and object inventory

scenario: Report authorized local Provider metrics
preconditions: Principal has object:list_prefix permission
expected_result: Only same-tenant local metrics returned
required_evidence: Diagnostics result and audit event

scenario: Create and validate consistent Provider DB snapshot
preconditions: Source Provider DB is open and receiving local operations
operation: Run online backup and integrity checks
expected_result: New immutable snapshot passes SQLite integrity and foreign-key checks
required_evidence: Snapshot SHA-256 and validation report

scenario: Seed external fencing floor and invalidate active sessions
preconditions: Validated backup and independently verified external floor exist
expected_result: All known scopes and new scopes are fenced at or above floor; unfinished multipart sessions removed; no cutover
required_evidence: Restoration report and source DB unchanged
notes: External reconciliation evidence is operator supplied and not authenticated by this tool

scenario: Reject unsafe in-place restore
preconditions: Destination exists or external floor/evidence reference missing
expected_result: Restore refused without overwriting source or destination
required_evidence: Original DB hashes and refusal details
